title: Michigan falls to 4, Vandy up to 10 in men's poll
summary: Arizona earned 60 of 61 first-place votes to remain No. 1 in the AP Top 25 poll. Michigan fell to No. 4 after suffering its first loss of the season, while unbeaten Vanderbilt moved into the top 10 for the first time since the 2011-12 season.
